Doorstep basket prawn toast.d: Ground with egg white, ginger and scallion on white bread, sesame pressed on, fried golden. Chili dip.

Bagel chips and schmear.d: Day-old bagel rounds sliced thin, oiled and baked crisp. Cream cheese beaten with chives and lemon zest.

Peter's loft steak sandwich.d: Sirloin seared hard and sliced thin, onions cooked slow in butter, horseradish mayo, Swiss melted over, toasted sourdough.
Peter's loft steak sandwich.note: The architect upstairs orders it every time.

Baby Mary's bedtime vanilla custard.d: Hot milk whisked into yolks and sugar, stirred low until thick. Warm or chilled.
Baby Mary's bedtime vanilla custard.note: Soft enough for the smallest regular.

Night-feed bourbon milk punch.d: Cold whole milk, vanilla, honey and syrup, shaken frothy on ice. Nutmeg.
Night-feed bourbon milk punch.note: For whoever is up at 2 A.M.
